scope: Current review evidence on localized versus distributed brain-wide representations supporting cognition.
summary: Current review evidence supports broadly distributed but not literally ubiquitous cognitive signals, reinforcing the bounded systems claim while qualifying simplistic localization and everything-everywhere accounts.
notes: No individual diagnostic inference is supported.

scope: Current mechanistic and authoritative sources on homeostatic and circadian sleep regulation and model refinement.
summary: The homeostatic-circadian interaction remains a major framework, while newer work refines how the processes interact and cautions against treating one formulation as biologically complete.
notes: Use as an educational framework, not a complete mechanistic or diagnostic model.

scope: Current major-depressive-disorder guideline evidence for CBT as an initial psychotherapy option.
summary: VA/DoD and ACP guidance support CBT as an evidence-based treatment option for adult MDD while preserving severity, feasibility, harms, comorbidity and patient-preference considerations.
notes: Does not establish superiority for every patient or diagnosis.

scope: Current bipolar guideline, taskforce, review and emerging trial evidence for IPSRT and comparative psychotherapy claims.
summary: IPSRT remains a recognized adjunctive psychotherapy with randomized evidence, but current VA/DoD guidance does not rank it above CBT, family/conjoint therapy or non-brief psychoeducation; a small 2026 trial is supportive but not sufficient to erase comparative uncertainty.
notes: Keep the claim conservative; do not upgrade to universal efficacy or superiority.

scope: Cross-guideline evidence on multimodal bipolar-disorder management and psychosocial/recovery-oriented care.
summary: Current NICE and VA/DoD guidance and a recent international-guideline review support multimodal bipolar care including psychosocial and pharmacological components rather than medication-only framing.
notes: This supports balanced treatment literacy, not anti-medication messaging.

scope: Current guideline and systematic-review evidence on ADHD diagnosis, rating scales, clinician judgment and multi-informant assessment.
summary: Newer diagnostic-tool evidence supports rating scales as useful aids while reinforcing that valid ADHD diagnosis requires experienced clinical judgment and broader multi-informant, multi-setting assessment.
notes: The boundary is not that rating scales are useless; it is that one scale/app/isolated complaint is insufficient.

scope: Dedicated current-guideline and meta-analytic supersession search for OCD/ERP beyond the older NICE CG31 source.
summary: Newer guideline and pediatric meta-analytic evidence continue to support ERP while adding comparator, age, treatment-format and risk-of-bias nuance.
notes: This claim was already advanced to contradiction_searched in the primary claim registry.

scope: Cross-guideline current-evidence check for PTSD/acute-stress treatment literacy using VA/DoD 2023 and APA 2025 guidance.
summary: Current VA/DoD and APA guidance both support an evidence-based PTSD treatment framework while explicitly preserving individualized history, preferences and professional judgment rather than converting guidelines into an automatic treatment selector.
notes: Supports Atlas AI prohibition on individualized treatment selection.

scope: Current CDC public guidance and active VA/DoD post-acute mTBI guideline evidence on cognitive symptoms, variability and prognosis boundaries.
summary: Current sources support cognitive symptoms and substantial individual variability after mild TBI/concussion while preserving the boundary against individualized prognosis, clearance or rehabilitation decisions from educational material.
notes: Persistent or urgent symptoms require appropriate clinical evaluation; the card is educational.
